newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam restates claim, demands in row with China.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam restates claim, demands in row with China.

text.p: Vietnam restated its claim on Thursday to a disputed offshore area of the South China Sea where Beijing has positioned an oil rig.
A foreign ministry spokesman, reading from a prepared statement, called for the rig to be withdrawn immediately and said Vietnam wanted negotiations as soon as possible to resolve the matter.
"As we have made clear, the area where the Chinese oil rig Kan Tan 111 is operating is completely located in the special economic zone and continental shelf of Vietnam," he said.
"... we have requested that experts from the two countries meet as soon as possible, at any place, to discuss this. We hope that China will positively respond to this request."
China's main offshore oil company said earlier on Thursday it had no immediate plans to move the drilling rig which was positioned in the area earlier this month.

"Any decision to leave the drilling area would be based on the drilling results," an official of the China National Offshore Oil Corp told Reuters. "Why should we leave the area?" said the official. "When the exploration is finished we will move the rig."
